purpose: Durable record of which descriptions and wiki articles have been editorially inspected and verified clean, so no future pass re-derives the question. LABOR prepares; TACHYON verifies against each record's own deposited body (AXN identity match + factual probes: distinctive figures and claimed quotations, name-quotes exempt); MANUS authority stands over both.

verification_standard.identity: batch AXN must equal registry AXN
verification_standard.factual: numeric and quotation probes checked case-insensitively against the deposited body + registry entry
verification_standard.disposition: seated only when hits >= misses; misses inspected individually before seating; no-change decisions honored as-is

staleness_gate.method: registry diff between pinned commit and HEAD across title/description/wiki/type/status/venue/version/pointer/body_status, plus stale-state language scan (retired vocabularies, stripped suffixes, superseded banners)

summary.note: Field hashes let a later pass detect drift: if a description/wiki no longer matches its recorded hash, it was changed after verification and needs re-inspection.
summary.staleness_protocol: Every batch is gated before seating: (1) registry diff between the batch's pinned commit and HEAD; (2) scan of proposed text for language describing states the campaign has since repaired. LABOR works from a frozen commit while TACHYON changes records underneath it — the gate is what keeps the streams from colliding.
